001package edu.pdx.cs.joy.whitlock;
002
003import org.jspecify.annotations.NonNull;
004import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
005
006import java.util.ArrayList;
007
008import static org.hamcrest.MatcherAssert.assertThat;
009import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.containsString;
010import static org.hamcrest.core.IsEqual.equalTo;
011import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
012
013/**
014 * Unit tests for the Student class.  In addition to the JUnit annotations,
015 * they also make use of the <a href="http://hamcrest.org/JavaHamcrest/">hamcrest</a>
016 * matchers for more readable assertion statements.
017 */
018public class StudentTest
019{
020
021  private static @NonNull Student createStudentNamed(String name) {
022    return new Student(name, new ArrayList<>(), 0.0, "other");
023  }
024
025
026  @Test
027  void studentNamedPatIsNamedPat() {
028    String name = "Pat";
029    var pat = createStudentNamed(name);
030    assertThat(pat.getName(), equalTo(name));
031  }
032
033  @Test
034  void allStudentsSayThisClassIsTooMuchWork() {
035    Student student = createStudentNamed("Pat");
036    assertThat(student.says(), equalTo("This class is too much work"));
037  }
038
039  @Test
040  void daveStudent() {
041    ArrayList<String> classes = new ArrayList<>();
042    classes.add("Algorithms");
043    classes.add("Operating Systems");
044    classes.add("Java");
045
046    Student dave = new Student("Dave", classes, 3.64, "male");
047    assertThat(dave.toString(), equalTo("Dave has a GPA of 3.64 and is taking 3 classes: Algorithms, Operating Systems, and Java.  He says \"This class is too much work\"."));
048  }
049
050  @Test
051  void toStringContainsStudentName() {
052    String name = "Pat";
053    Student student = createStudentNamed(name);
054    assertThat(student.toString(), containsString(name));
055  }
056
057  @Test
058  void toStringContainsGPA() {
059    double gpa = 3.64;
060    Student student = new Student("Name", new ArrayList<>(), gpa, "male");
061    assertThat(student.toString(), containsString(" has a GPA of " + gpa));
062  }
063
064  @Test
065  void negativeGPAThrowsInvalidRangeException() {
066    double invalidGPA = -1.0;
067
068    InvalidGPAException e = assertThrows(InvalidGPAException.class, () -> new Student("Name", new ArrayList<>(), invalidGPA, "male"));
069    assertThat(e.getInvalidGPA(), equalTo(invalidGPA));
070  }
071
072  @Test
073  void toStringContainsZeroClasses() {
074    Student student = new Student("Name", new ArrayList<>(), 3.64, "male");
075    assertThat(student.toString(), containsString(" and is taking 0 classes."));
076  }
077
078  @Test
079  void toStringContainsTwoClasses() {
080    ArrayList<String> classes = new ArrayList<>();
081    classes.add("Algorithms");
082    classes.add("Operating Systems");
083
084    Student student = new Student("Name", classes, 3.64, "male");
085    assertThat(student.toString(), containsString(" and is taking 2 classes: Algorithms and Operating Systems."));
086  }
087
088  @Test
089  void gpaGreaterThan4point0ThrowsInvalidRangeException() {
090    double invalidGPA = 4.1;
091
092    InvalidGPAException e = assertThrows(InvalidGPAException.class, () -> new Student("Name", new ArrayList<>(), invalidGPA, "male"));
093    assertThat(e.getInvalidGPA(), equalTo(invalidGPA));
094  }
095
096  @Test
097  void toStringContainsOneClass() {
098    ArrayList<String> classes = new ArrayList<>();
099    classes.add("Algorithms");
100
101    Student student = new Student("Name", classes, 3.64, "male");
102    assertThat(student.toString(), containsString(" and is taking 1 class: Algorithms."));
103  }
104
105  @Test
106  void toStringContainsThreeClasses() {
107    ArrayList<String> classes = new ArrayList<>();
108    classes.add("Algorithms");
109    classes.add("Operating Systems");
110    classes.add("Java");
111
112    Student student = new Student("Name", classes, 3.64, "male");
113    assertThat(student.toString(), containsString(" and is taking 3 classes: Algorithms, Operating Systems, and Java."));
114  }
115
116  @Test
117  void toStringContainsFourClasses() {
118    ArrayList<String> classes = new ArrayList<>();
119    classes.add("Algorithms");
120    classes.add("Operating Systems");
121    classes.add("Java");
122    classes.add("AI");
123
124    Student student = new Student("Name", classes, 3.64, "male");
125    assertThat(student.toString(), containsString(" and is taking 4 classes: Algorithms, Operating Systems, Java, and AI."));
126  }
127
128  @Test
129  void femalePronounIsShe() {
130    Student student = new Student("Name", new ArrayList<>(), 3.64, "female");
131    assertThat(student.getPronoun(), equalTo("She"));
132  }
133
134  @Test
135  void malePronounIsHe() {
136    Student student = new Student("Name", new ArrayList<>(), 3.64, "male");
137    assertThat(student.getPronoun(), equalTo("He"));
138  }
139
140  @Test
141  void otherPronounIsThey() {
142    Student student = new Student("Name", new ArrayList<>(), 3.64, "other");
143    assertThat(student.getPronoun(), equalTo("They"));
144  }
145
146  @Test
147  void mixedCaseFemaleGender() {
148    Student student = new Student("Name", new ArrayList<>(), 3.64, "Female");
149    assertThat(student.getPronoun(), equalTo("She"));
150  }
151
152  @Test
153  void unsupportedGenderThrowsUnsupportedGenderException() {
154    UnsupportedGenderException ex = assertThrows(UnsupportedGenderException.class, () -> new Student("Name", new ArrayList<>(), 3.64, "unsupported"));
155    assertThat(ex.getUnsupportedGender(), equalTo("unsupported"));
156  }
157
158  @Test
159  void shePronounInToString() {
160    Student student = new Student("Name", new ArrayList<>(), 3.64, "Female");
161    assertThat(student.toString(), containsString(".  She says "));
162  }
163
164  @Test
165  void hePronounInToString() {
166    Student student = new Student("Name", new ArrayList<>(), 3.64, "male");
167    assertThat(student.toString(), containsString(".  He says "));
168  }
169
170  @Test
171  void theyPronounInToString() {
172    Student student = new Student("Name", new ArrayList<>(), 3.64, "other");
173    assertThat(student.toString(), containsString(".  They say "));
174  }
175
176  @Test
177  void saysInToString() {
178    Student student = new Student("Name", new ArrayList<>(), 3.64, "male");
179    assertThat(student.toString(), containsString(" \"This class is too much work\"."));
180  }
181}
